messages:
maria: Customer C-9482 reports p95 spikes and intermittent 502/504s on our hosted inference endpoint since yesterday evening. They see large slowdowns at ~600ms->3s p95 with throughput 120 rps.
maria: Root request example IDs they captured: req_01FZ9A6K, req_01FZ9B3L, req_01FZA0QX. Asking for a reproducible pack (curl ids + token counts + small promptset) and a debug bundle.
jonah: Thanks — can you paste a minimal curl that reproduces the slow path? Also need concurrency profile and avg token lengths.
maria: They sent this curl (sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"rw-large-1","input":"Summarize the following: <payload>","max_tokens":256}'
```
maria: Payload size is ~1.6k chars, typical user flow is bursts of 8 concurrent requests from a serverless function. Avg tokens in prompt ~140, response ~220.
ryan: Can we get the exact 3 request IDs (from customer logs) and the gateway logs around those times? If they have the x-request-id header we can correlate on edge -> runtime.
maria: Provided timestamps for two spikes: 2026-03-14T22:37:12Z (req_01FZ9A6K) and 2026-03-14T23:11:05Z (req_01FZ9B3L). They attached HAR excerpt and a short flame graph screenshot.
sre-bot: @jonah created debug-bundle job id: dbg-20260315-7362. Uploads expected in ~30m.
jonah: I'll kick off a targeted debug collection on the tenant (cust-C-9482) for a 15m window and capture kernel logs, runtime traces, and NGINX timing. Need the customer's IP ranges (can be obfuscated) and whether they used dedicated or hosted.
maria: They confirm hosted (shared tier) and live in us-west-2. IPs: 54.221.33.12 (app server), 34.80.110.9 (CI runner). They consent to debug bundle.
ryan: For repro pack please ask them to run a small stress script with the following concurrency pattern: 1-min warmup at 4 rps, 3 mins ramp to 8 concurrency steady, then 2x burst for 30s at 16 concurrent. Include token counts: prompt 140, max_tokens 220. Example locust/snippet below.
maria: Posting small stress script (python, requests):
```python
import requests, threading, time
url='https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate'
headers={'Authorization':'Bearer <REDACTED>','Content-Type':'application/json'}
body={"model":"rw-large-1","input":"Summarize this...","max_tokens":220}

def worker():
  r=requests.post(url,json=body,headers=headers,timeout=20)
  print(r.status_code, r.headers.get('x-request-id'), len(r.content))

# spawn threads per pattern (warmup -> steady -> burst)
```
jonah: Good. Also request they set header `X-Debug-Enable: true` so our gateway will add tracing identifiers. If they can't, ask for the full raw response including x-request-id header values.
samantha: I pulled recent infra metrics for that timeframe — small p95 blips tracked with a concurrent batch flush on a serving host. I'll attach the p95 and queue depth graphs to the debug bundle.
ryan: One more ask: include the exact prompt set (5 unique prompts covering short/long/prefix-heavy) so we can run a representative promptset in the repro pack. Example prompts: "summarize", "rewrite`, longer doc, Q&A, code completion.
maria: Customer uploaded promptset.txt (5 prompts), HAR excerpt, and a small CSV with captured x-request-id -> latency mapping. Link: s3://redwood-debug/c-9482/1842001234/
jonah: I'll correlate the x-request-ids with runtime trace dbg-20260315-7362 and follow up with a concrete repro pack (curl pack + token matrix). Expect an update in ~2 hours.
maria: Thank you — marking this as P2 escalated. I'll notify customer once we have the repro pack. :thumbsup:
ryan: If we reproduce latency locally we should try quantization variant (rw-large-1-q4) and a smaller batch window to validate mitigation. Note in the notes that this customer is on shared capacity so fallback policy might route to cheaper model under load.
jonah: Acknowledge. I'll include a short checklist in the debug bundle: 1) raw requests (curl ids) 2) promptset + token stats 3) concurrency config 4) gateway + runtime traces 5) infra p95/queue graphs.
maria: All set, leaving thread open for attachments. If anyone on-call needs to jump ping me or @jonah.
